## Dieses Dokument

- Titel: Brief von Stefan Zweig an Hannah; Altmann, Manfred Altmann [August 1941], SZ-AAL/B1.157
- Signatur: SZ-AAL/B1.157
- Datum: 08.1941
- Objekttyp: Brief
- Umfang: 5 Scans

pages.transcription:
Dear H. & M. We just are returning from Croton where we visited
Eva the day before our departure and we went even with her to
a bar after with Philip Miller. We regretted to leave her
behind but to let her start in a new language would be too much
and especially as we have the impression that she feels perfectly
right and is very happy there. Mr. Haeffner is absolutely reliable
and the new house is just a dream - you cannot imagine
what an enormous park it has the Mr Cooks at Bath. They
could only take it over because the taxes for private owners
are too high.
Thanks so much for all the trouble you took again in
their discussions. I like Gilbert and hope he does his best,
infortunately I am pretty sure that I will have some day
complications with his boss. I can understand it as his
financial position is difficult, and that he will become
more and more disagreeable. Thats why I wanted you to
let things go and to keep away and not to loose your time,
I do not want that you have to do with all this - {here} I
will have a friend of mine to discuss all possible compli-
cations. You have your own worries.
It is interesting that you told me about the possibili-
ty of a house for Manfred new Xray practice. Nobody
can tell if it is wise or not, for a house in London it
means certainly a risk as long as the war goes on and
in any case one should take a mortgage on it. I understand
so well that he as a doctor and specialist cannot live
always in a flat - a small one is impossible, a large
one too expensive. Of course you should buy it in your both
names jointly as nobody can tell what may happen to
one or to the other in these times; my friends Wooster &

[Randnotiz links, von unten nach oben geschrieben:]
Please send the Penclub a contribution for the Congress fund
in my name, perhaps for L. as 7 cannot be present myself
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief in violetter Tinte. Die Randnotiz links ist vertikal geschrieben.
Rückseite des ersten Blattes, durchscheinender Text der Vorderseite erkennbar, aber kein eigenständiger Text.

pages.transcription:
Prof would do all to be helpful to you with any kind
of advise as tolles husband [?] is not able to help
you directly. You understand that I do not encourage you
neither discourage you - all is risk now, mere chance if
a bomb finds its way this street or the other street. But in
any case it would be something for your daughter one day
and if you have happy hours only in outfitting it, you have
already had something. We are all gamblers today with
whatever we do, wherever we go, wherever we are - the
great game is not in our hands. Personally I would be
glad to know that you {both} own a house again even with mort-
gages and that Manfred can have his Xray apparatus and
his other medical work in comparatively safely.
I am glad that you meet the Kormendis. His play is
excellent, also Tilop Miller was enthusiastic about it
He know no better author - play and I hope he has a
good agent here in Newyork. If not I would advise him
to send over more copies to prominent people - I am
sure that if anybody with influence gets it into his hands
it will be produced at least at the radio
About Freeman I wrote you already that for the moment
I am not interested in books etc. I want to avoid all
what complicates matters - they will be complicated enough
as what goes one. All what I want is to forget everything
I had and everything I was formerly and to try again
to write new books for the old and forgotten ones - the
autobiografy is quasi finished and I hope quite an interes-
ting book. The other on Brazil will be sent in 4 weeks
to you directly by the publishers. Please remember Hannah

[Randnotiz links, von unten nach oben geschrieben:]
To charge all the expenses out she had and I want that she is rewarded
regularly for all the true cost. Steel Celler comes from the Coat
we will have more here. Yours Stefan
